articles.title: A Tiny Robot That Swims With Living Muscles
articles.summary: MIT engineers built a gum-sized swimming robot powered by a layer of living muscle cells that contract under light, letting them steer it through an underwater maze.

articles.title: A $10 Chip That Could Put a Medical Lab on Your Wrist
articles.summary: Cambridge researchers built a $10 light-analyzing chip, just centimeters wide, that identified materials perfectly in tests and measured health markers including blood glucose without needles.

articles.title: Shooting Stars From Halley's Comet Light Up the Autumn Sky
articles.summary: Astrophotographer Tim McCollum combined many long exposures to capture three Orionid meteors - debris from Halley's Comet - above Georgia, and the shower remains active until November 7.
